name: Data Converter
description: Convert anything in one DBX workbench panel: 13 formats (JSON / YAML / XML / Properties / TOML / INI / .env / CSV / TSV / Query / Headers / Cookie / HTML) in any combination, JSONPath / jq queries with JSON Schema validation, eight escape tools (URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON / Unicode / Hex / SQL / Regex), batch text to SQL (IN / NOT IN / INSERT), .xlsx / .csv / .tsv to JSON, Image ⇄ Base64, and a Byte Converter (B/KB/MB/GB/TB/PB on both the 1000 and 1024 scales, exact ⇄ human readable, batch totals, plus hex dump / byte array / binary string). A Time Converter turns timestamps and dates into each other (local, T-separated, UTC, ISO 8601 and relative) one value per line, with foldable results and copies that carry results only. A Code Gen page turns a JSON sample or a CREATE TABLE into TypeScript / Go / Java / Python models, and a Chart page renders an ECharts option (or bare numbers) as a real chart, 700 x 400 by default with custom width and height, exported as PNG or SVG, and a QR code page turns any text into a batch of codes (size, error correction, margin and colours adjustable, an icon in the middle, PNG or SVG export) or decodes pictures back into text. The navigation bar is yours to arrange: drag the eleven entries into your own order, pin the ones you use most (they are the last to fall into More when the window narrows), keep the bar sticky, or move the whole thing into a left-hand column that folds away with one click; the setup is remembered along with the layout. Press Ctrl/Cmd + K to search the panel by Chinese, English, synonyms, full pinyin or initials — formats, conversion directions and the tabs inside each page included. Pure frontend, no backend, works offline.
releaseNotes: Search now lives in the top bar itself: a magnifier button (or Cmd+K on macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere) lends the navigation row to a search field, so nothing ever floats over the page or covers the format toolbar — the field is part of the bar, the entries fold away while you type and come back when you leave. It reaches anything in one word: Chinese, English, a synonym, the full pinyin or just the initials — sj / shijian / unix / 时间戳 all land on the Time Converter, bt / 对比 / diff all land on JSON Compare, jiami / encode all land on the Escape tools. Formats are searchable too, so toml, 从 toml or 转为 toml jumps straight into the right converter and flips the right side once it gets there; results are ranked pages first, then directions, then formats, so searching json does not bury the page under format entries. Arrow keys move, Enter goes straight to the page (the pick calls the navigation handler itself, so it also works inside the host webview), Esc closes, and a keystroke that belongs to a Chinese input method is never stolen from it. The left-hand column now folds away with one click of the button beside the title and slides back the same way, and its state is remembered with the order, pins and stickiness. The icon-only buttons finally explain themselves on hover — the webview swallows native title bubbles, so the tip is drawn by the page, in the current language. Fixed in this release: after a refactor the panel could fail to load at all inside the workbench, because a comment had been written with a real script tag in it — the host scans index.html with a regex, tried to read that file, and returned 400 for the whole frame; the comment is plain prose now and a test scans every inlined script and stylesheet for the same trap. The pale strip that ran along the sidebar divider was the navigation list's own scrollbar track; the column is now a single scrolling block with the scrollbar hidden, so the divider is one unbroken 1px line and page content keeps 5px of air from it.  Search now reaches inside the pages as well: the tabs and direction switches are indexed too, so 转图片 lands on the Image page with Base64 → image already selected, INSERT and Schema jump straight to the SQL template or the validator, Go / Java / Python land on that language, and a repeated name such as 解码 shows which page owns it on the right. Names are read from the buttons themselves and pinyin is derived from the name, so a new language costs nothing and a new tab only needs one line in the table. Also fixed: in the desktop host, typing Chinese and pressing a digit to pick a candidate did nothing — the search box was clearing its value and folding itself away on an empty query, which Blink tolerates but WebKit (inside the host) answers by dropping the candidate window. Nothing is re-rendered, cleared or closed while a composition is in progress; the search runs once the characters land, and keys that belong to the input method are never taken. Internally the page was split from one 20,000-line file into 18 focused modules plus a stylesheet, which is why the next feature has somewhere obvious to live.

zh-CN.name: 数据转换
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 工作台里一次转完：JSON / YAML / XML / Properties / TOML / INI / .env / CSV / TSV / Query / Headers / Cookie / HTML 共 13 种格式任意互转、JSONPath / jq 查询与 JSON Schema 校验（含从样例反推 Schema）、URL / Base64 / HTML / JSON / Unicode / Hex / SQL / 正则 8 种转义互转、字节换算（B / KB / MB / GB / TB / PB，1000 与 1024 两套进制，精确值 ⇄ 人类可读，批量求和，以及 hex dump / 字节数组 / 二进制串）、批量文本生成 SQL（IN / NOT IN / INSERT）、.xlsx / .csv / .tsv 转 JSON，以及图片 ↔ Base64；「代码生成」页把一段 JSON 示例或一条 CREATE TABLE 直接变成 TypeScript / Go / Java / Python 模型；「JSON 转图表」页把一段 ECharts option（或一组数字）直接画成图，默认 700 × 400、宽高可改，可导出 PNG / SVG；「时间转换」页把时间戳与日期批量互转（本地时间 / `T` 分隔 / UTC / ISO 8601 / 相对时间任选，结果可折叠、可单个复制）；「二维码转换」页把一段文本批量生成二维码（尺寸 / 纠错 / 边距 / 配色可调，中心可放图标，导出 PNG / SVG），也能把图片里的二维码解回文本。导航栏可以自己排：拖动调整十一个入口的顺序、把常用项置顶（窗口变窄时最后才被收进「更多」）、导航条吸顶，还能整列挪到左侧、用完一键收起，设置连同布局一起记住；`Ctrl/⌘ + K` 搜功能，中文 / 英文 / 近义词 / 全拼 / 首字母都能命中，各页的格式、转换方向与页内 tab（转图片 / INSERT / Schema 校验 / Go …）也搜得到。纯前端、无后端、可离线运行。

zh-TW.name: 資料轉換
